S31.name: 皱鳃鲨
S31.form: an eel-like body, six gill slits on each side with frilled and overlapping gill septa, a very short snout, a wide mouth set at the front, teeth of the same shape in both jaws with three long cusps each, nostrils on the lower side of the head, a spiracle
S31.fins: a small leaf-shaped dorsal fin positioned between the pelvic-fin base and behind the anal fin, an anal fin larger than the dorsal fin, small paddle-shaped pectoral fins

S32.name: 雪茄达摩鲨
S32.form: a small spindle-shaped body, a short snout, a horizontal mouth with a well-developed upper lip, hooked teeth in the upper jaw and large upright overlapping teeth in the lower jaw
S32.fins: small pectoral fins, pelvic fins taller than the two dorsal fins, no anal fin, a short broad broom-shaped tail fin
S32.markings: a transverse band crossing the belly between the gill openings in front of the pectoral fins
S32.colour: 体背暗褐色，腹部浅褐色或淡白色；鳍褐色，胸鳍、背鳍和腹鳍具淡白色边缘

S33.name: 六鳃鲨
S33.form: a long stout body, a short blunt snout, a large curved mouth, six pairs of gill slits set obliquely and wide, large eyes
S33.fins: an anal fin smaller than the dorsal fin, the anal-fin origin below the rear part of the dorsal-fin base
S33.colour: 体色从背面灰黑色到巧克力棕色不等，腹部为灰白色；眼为萤光绿色

S34.name: 深海龙鱼
S34.form: a small elongated body, a large head, a huge mouth, sharp nail-like teeth in the upper and lower jaws, small sharp teeth on the upper jaw and tongue, tubular eyes, entirely scaleless skin
S34.markings: two rows of luminous photophores along the flanks, a luminous lure on the barbel of the lower jaw

S35.name: 深海银鲛
S35.form: an elongated tapering body, a large head with a blunt snout, large eyes, smooth scaleless skin, the gill slits covered by a single operculum
S35.fins: two dorsal fins with a stout spine in front of the first, large wing-like pectoral fins, a long whip-like tail

S36.name: 单棘魨
S36.form: a laterally compressed elongated body, a small pointed head, a small terminal mouth, leathery skin with small scales, a prominent first dorsal spine above the eye
S36.fins: a first dorsal fin reduced to a single stout spine, a second dorsal fin, a small anal fin, a rounded tail fin

S37.name: 蓝环章鱼
S37.form: a small rounded body, eight arms, a body covered in small spots
S37.markings: rings around the eye spots, rings on the arms, spots covering the whole body
S37.colour: 通常呈深棕色、深黄色或棕褐色，眼斑周围具有鲜艳的彩虹蓝色环纹，全身布满青蓝色斑点
